test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 9 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.

I __guessed her feelings__ when she started crying.
solution:
The correct answer is **Estimated her emotions.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence can be improved by replacing the **"guessed her feelings" **with** "estimated her emotions."**
 
• When one talks about emotions or feelings, the "guess" word should not be used as guess is very quick to judge. but estimation takes time. 
 
• Thus, the correct option is **Estimated her emotions.**

The correct sentence is: **I estimated her emotions when she started crying. **
